notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item used once (pools exactly 4x each count). Per test biology 30, chemistry 20: the real 60:40 split at UMF Carol Davila (60 questions on the compulsory subject, 40 on the chosen one). Training: five topic sets 24801-24805 (nervous system and senses 52, movement and digestion 36, blood, circulation, respiration, excretion, reproduction 32, hydrocarbons and functional groups 52, biological compounds 28), so 5 sets + 4 tests = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 80 is Tigertest's target: admission is ranked by score, minimum grade 5 at Carol Davila.
